content: José-e-nog sagu-yaba odolesad
Mas-guchamalad-sorbali, José dule-ega-neg-akwedga weyob igar-uksad: “We-dulemar-saguyaba orosgi-dakleged nue-ise-enamakar be balo. Degine, mani egad-egad e-sagu-yaba ega be urbebalo.
Deginbali, an-mani-nog e-urba-bipigwad-sagu-yaba be odogo. Degine, orosgi-dakleged-baksad-e-mani agi be odobalo. Nog, mani-ebo walikaa be sio.” Joséʼga-neg-akwed José-ega-sogedba imaksad.
Geb dad-nakwialiyalaba, José negse e-gwenadgan-barmialid. José-e-gwenadgan e-moli-uayasuid egad-egadgi armalad.

José-e-gwenadgan neggweburgi amba itakasaar-nadapidgine, José ega-neg-akwedga sogded: “We-machergan-naded be bareginna. Be bargasale, ega be sogo: ‘¿Ibiga dule-ibmar-nued-bega-imaksadgi be isdar binsasmala? ¿Ibiga be e-mani-nog atursasmala?
We-mani-nog an-dummad gobega ebuged, degi, Bab-Dummadse-idakega ebubalid. ¡Bemar nue-dummad nosmalad!’ ”
Joséʼga-neg-akwed José-e-gwenadgan-bargasgu, bela deyob ega sogdapid.
Agi, José-e-gwenadgan abin sogdemalad: —Dummad, ¿ibiga weyob be anmarga soge? ¡Anmar weyob geg ibmar imaked!
Anmar-sagu-yaba mani-bukwa anmar dakargusadi, a-mani Canaán-yar-akar anmarde bega ukega gannar sear gusad. Degite, ¿igi anmar be-dummad-neggi, mani, degi, olo atursaosunna? Geg anmar atursaed.
¡Ar doa-saguyaba nog-sii dakledagoe, a-dule oburgwilegodo. Geb degine, anmarmoga bela be-dummad-maiga gumarmogodo!
Geb degine, Joséʼga-neg-akwed sogded: —Bemar-sogedyob imaklegodo. Degi-inigwele, unnila ar doa nog-ganiki, abi unnila an-maiga guoed. Ar bemar-baigandi akarsurdo. Na be namalodo.
Belagwable na egad-egad yog sagu napase odedmalad, degi, egadmalad.
Joséʼga-neg-akwed sagu wargwen-wargwengi nog-amided. Ia-dummadgi onoded, geb bipigwadse warmaksad. Geb Benjamín-sagu-yaba nog sii daklealid.
Bela mor esirmakdemalad, oyogega, emarde nunmak-itomarye. Geb a-sorbali, e-sagu moli-uayasuid-birgi-onakwismargu, bela gannar neggweburse armalad.
Judá, degi, e-gwenadgan José-negse-nonimargu, amba José e-neggi-sii daknonimalad. Geb degine, bela José-asabin dulluu e-bebe napase ebulegedse imakdemalad.
Ar Joséʼdi amarga sogded: —¿Ar igi be anga gudmala? ¿Ar bemar wissurmarsi, dule-anyobidi Bab-Dummadse-idakedba sunna ibmar wisgued?

Judá abin-sogded: —¿Ar igi anmar be-abin-imakosunna? ¿Ar igi anmar sogosunna, anmar deyob ibmar imaksasurye? Ar Bab-Dummadde anmar-daksad, anmar nue-dummad nosad. Degisoggu, wegi anmar, degi, dule-sagu-yaba be-nog-amilesad, be-maiga gumarsunnodo.
Ar José abin-sogded: —Suli, deyob geg gue. Unnila doa-sagu-yaba an-nog amilesa, abi an-maiga guoed. Baigandi sunna be-bab-negse gannar baisur-itogedgi namalad.
Judá Benjamín-ular sunmaksad
Geb degine, Judá Joséʼse naded, ega sogded: —Dummad, bese wilesakwaa an egised, begarbi an sogbied. Dummad, ar be Faraón-sunnadyobmosoggu, mer be anse urwo.
Be anmarse egichisgusad, anmarde bab-nikamar-sogeye, degi, be urba-baid-nikamarbar-sogeye.

Anmar be-abin-imaksagusad, anmar-bab selebagusye. Anmar urba-bipigwad nikabarye. We-machi anmar-bab selebagusadgine nikusye. Degine, anmar bega sogsabalid, anmar-bab bela-bela we-machigwa-sabye. Ar ade, unnila nan-wargwengi webi-walagwenad, e-ia-nan-galagwenad burgwisad.
”Geb degine, be anmarga sogsagusad: ‘Be-urba be anga sedamaloye,’ ar ade, be dakbigusad.
Anmar bega sogsagusad: ‘Dummad, machigwa geg e-babgi banguye. Ar e-babgi bangudele, e-bab burgwisarye.’
Ar bede anmarga sogsagusad: ‘Machigwa bemarba danisulile, an bemar-abingaosurye.’
”Anmar gannar anmar-babse warmakdapgu, be-anmarga-sogsadi, bela anmar ega sogdapid.
”Geb degine, anmar-bab anmarga weyob igar-uksad: ‘Gannar bemar Egiptoʼse orosgi-dakleged wis baknamarbarye.’
Ar anmardi abin-imaksad: ‘Anmar-urba anmarba nasulir, anmar geg naye. Ar anmarba nasulir, dule-dummad-mas-uked anmar-abindakosurye.’
”Anmar-bab anmarga sogsagusad: ‘An-ome-Raquelʼbo an masmala-warbo-nikusad be wismarye.
A-wargwenadi angi bangusad-akar bar an gwen dakdisurye. Ibmar-durgan-sapurbalid an-machi-ichimaksad an bensurye.
Ar an-machi-baid bemar angi sedbalile, igarba-akar-gunonikile, bemarginye. An dule-selebagusad, bukib-binsaedba-burgwider, bemarginbarye.’ ”
Judá Joséʼga sogdebalid: —Ar an-bab we-machigwa-ebo bela-bela walikasoggu, anmarba gannar nasulile,
sate dakalile, anmar-bab burgoed. Degisoggu, anmar-bab-selebagusad, bukib-binsaedba burgwider, anmargindo.
An-babga an sogsad: ‘Ani an bega machigwa nue-dakoye.’ Deginbali, an ega sogsabalid: ‘Machigwa gannar an bega senonisulile, an-burgwedse angi atakledii guoye.’
”A-ulale, wilesakwaa an bese egised, ani an machigwa-anar be-maigaguega be an-imaksundo. Machigwa e-iamarba-naega be imake.
Ar degisulile, ¿igi an machigwasuli gannar an-babse an naosunna? An-bab nue-dummad-wilegoed an dakbisulid.”
